fields.source_ref: src/components/course/panels/earthmodel/PopulationExplorer.jsx:96 (Kriged at a probe point tile; type x 1500, y 2500 with Simple kriging, nugget 0.00025, range 900)
fields.recommendation: Add the tile at 6 decimals and tighten tol to 0.0002 so the mean no longer passes; owner to accept the tightening.
fields.evidence: New probe readout with x/y inputs; krigeAt(1500, 2500) = 0.2914277719922997 exactly (populationLab.test.js). Its default location is PROBE_DEFAULT (2000, 2300), which reads 0.279119 and, under every nugget/range option, stays > 0.0017 from the key, so no default state prints it (D2). At tol 0.0002 the mean 0.290516 (0.00091 away) fails; the nugget-0 value 0.291597 (1.7e-4) still passes, as the B5 annotation noted. Rounding miss at 6 dp 2.3e-7. The advanced m06 l04 walkthrough now names the readout and the 0.0002 tolerance; m05 l03/l05 no longer describe the nugget sweep as "one tolerance".
fields.notes: LEAK: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/content/courses/earthmodel/advanced/m06-per-block-volume-and-the-workflow/l04-the-capstone-walkthrough.md prints this value, and the PopulationExplorer default state shows it (probe). The m05 l05 lesson prints 0.2914277719922997 verbatim. Tightening tol to 0.0002 can flip a pass to a fail (flag); it would still admit the nugget sweep (0 gives 0.29160) but reject the mean, the trend (0.295) and the per-block value (0.28627).

rekey_annot.evidence: computePopulation() profile[12].phi - profile[11].phi = -0.023016035393453593 (pinned in populationLab.test.js with a sweep over all 48 method/nugget/range settings, every other one more than 5e-5 away: nearest -0.0231041 at range 300 and -0.0228259 at range 600; trend -0.0210, constant -0.028688; unsigned +0.023016 is 0.046 away). Printed at 6 dp, rounding miss 3.5e-8. The panel opens on simple kriging at the golden variogram, so the DEFAULT STATE PRINTS IT (earthmodel is a full W5 re-case). Lessons reworded so no figure within tol survives: m01 l04 printed it to full precision and "about 0.292" at x 1600 (0.292 - 0.315 = -0.023 passes), m04 l05 printed "krige minus 0.0230".
